# `@auvora/cache`

**Status:** incubating (Phase 13).

In-memory / Redis-ready cache primitives for cross-service reuse. Not yet wired into Nest services — adopt deliberately (TD-M1) rather than ad-hoc copies.

## Usage

```ts
import {} from /* exports from package */ '@auvora/cache';
```

See `src/index.ts` and unit tests for the supported surface.
